# About

Welcome to my website! I am currently working as a Financial Stability Expert at the European Central Bank on topics relating to financial stability and systemic risk. In early 2026 I return to the Central Bank of Ireland to work as a Senior Economist in the Irish Economic Analysis Division. My research interests span topics in banking, artificial intelligence and the international transmission of macroeconomic and financial shocks. I hold a PhD in Economics from Trinity College, Dublin.

**Research interests** Banking, artificial intelligence, financial stability, systemic risk, international transmission of macroeconomic and financial shocks
